notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 28 layers x 2 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 28,672 B/token (28.0 KiB). head_dim is not in config.json: derived as hidden_size 1536 / 12 attention heads = 128. Uniform full attention, no sliding window. config.json ships torch_dtype float32, which would double this to 57,344 B/token uncast; the figure assumes the bf16 serving the card's vLLM/TGI/SGLang guidance implies. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card table lists all five benchmarks with matching values (AIME 2024, MATH-500, AMC 2023, Minerva Math, OlympiadBench).
